title: C++ Input/Output Library Reference
author: cppreference.com
stopping_guidance: Read the sections on standard input streams and output formatting. Stop when you understand cin, cout, and basic type formatting for integers and strings.

title: C++ Statements and Control Flow
author: cppreference.com
stopping_guidance: Focus on expression statements, compound statements, selection statements (if, switch), and iteration statements (for, while). Skip jump statements for now.

title: C++ std::vector Container Reference
author: cppreference.com
stopping_guidance: Study member functions push_back, size, operator[], and range-based for loop iteration. Skip allocator and capacity management details.

title: C++ Functions Language Reference
author: cppreference.com
stopping_guidance: Read function declarations, parameter passing by value and reference, return types, and overload resolution basics. Skip lambda expressions and templates.

title: GDB: The GNU Project Debugger Manual
author: GNU Project
stopping_guidance: Read chapters on breakpoints, stepping through code, inspecting variables, and backtrace. Stop after the basic debugging workflow chapter.

title: Git Basics: Getting a Git Repository
author: Git SCM Community
stopping_guidance: Complete the Git Basics chapter through recording changes and viewing history. Skip the remote repositories section for now.

title: Algorithm Complexity Analysis Guide
author: OI Wiki Contributors
stopping_guidance: Read the introduction to time complexity, Big-O notation, and common complexity classes. Practice estimating complexity from nested loop examples.

title: C++ Algorithm Library: lower_bound
author: cppreference.com
stopping_guidance: Study std::sort, std::lower_bound, and std::upper_bound. Understand the requirement of sorted ranges for binary search algorithms.

title: C++ std::queue Container Reference
author: cppreference.com
stopping_guidance: Read queue, stack, and deque adapter documentation. Focus on push, pop, front, top, and empty operations for both containers.

title: C++ std::unordered_map Container Reference
author: cppreference.com
stopping_guidance: Study operator[], insert, find, count, and erase for unordered_map and unordered_set. Understand hash-based lookup complexity guarantees.

title: Depth-First Search and Tree Traversal Guide
author: OI Wiki Contributors
stopping_guidance: Read DFS basics, recursion patterns, and tree traversal sections. Focus on preorder, inorder, and postorder traversal applications.

title: Breadth-First Search Algorithm Guide
author: OI Wiki Contributors
stopping_guidance: Read BFS algorithm, queue-based implementation, and shortest-path applications on unweighted graphs. Study the step-by-step example walkthrough.
